scope: Built-in 2B CPU chat, matching vision, native PP-OCRv5, host-owned preferences and optional external services; current source qualification tracked separately.

runtime.tested_platform: Four native CPU text paths in alpha.1 and four native OCR paths in run38104493062; application screen/TCC/hardware qualification tracked in validation docs.

prompt_baseline.description: App text slice uses editable gentle/playful GUI personality, short=96 or normal=192 output tokens; historical research prompts remain reproducible.
prompt_baseline.release_validation: Native chat and observation qualification tracked in docs/validation/local-ai-observation-2026-10-11.md; target hardware and full visual quality still pending.
prompt_baseline.latency_note: Historical text timing unchanged; six actual 2B image calls are in docs/research/vision-2b-2026-10-11.md. Shared/contended CPU, not target i5 benchmark.

capabilities.image_capability_note: Matching 2B projector downloaded, checksum verified and six Linux CPU image requests executed; injection-quality failures retained. App scopes are enforced separately.
capabilities.sqlite_capability_note: Durable preferences are extracted from explicit user-chat statements by host rules. Model replies and screen text cannot write preferences.

observation_plan.ocr_trial: Pinned PP-OCRv5 mobile CPU ONNX Runtime1.23.2 native worker; Python is build/test tooling only.
observation_plan.vision: Matching 671372416-byte BF16 projector bundled; 256 image tokens /80 output tokens on user request; ordinary background observation OCR-only.
observation_plan.routing: OCR first for screen text; 2B images only for user requests or image-dominant observations, no concurrent heavy inference by default.

release_blockers: Exact-source application build/regression and downloadable assets
Native macOS authorized capture, Windows mixed-DPI/multi-screen and lock-screen checks
8GB 11th-gen i5 native CPU/RAM and long office-use evaluation
50 independent image/screen quality cases and per-device GPU qualification

selection_policy.tolerated: Low-risk factual slips and playful imagined dog actions; not automatic rejection.
host_owned_boundaries: long-term preference source and actual writes

target_hardware.cpu: Intel Core i5 11th generation; exact SKU pending native benchmark
target_hardware.status: user selected target, not tested device
target_hardware.threads: benchmark 2 and 4 workers; leave responsiveness headroom, do not assume double speed
